name: Build Android APK on: workflow_dispatch: jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '20' - uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: 'temurin' java-version: '17' - run: | mkdir -p www cp index.html www/index.html npm init -y npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android npx cap init "Ogrenci Sinav Analizi" "com.sinav.analizi" --web-dir=www npx cap add android npx cap sync android - name: Mikrofon iznini ekle run: | python3 -c ' p = "android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml" s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read() s = s.replace("\n" s = s.replace("
